question: what does this red error mean

packet.utterance: what does this red error mean

facts: it's a CORS block: the API at localhost:8080 answered without an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so the browser refused to hand the response to the page on localhost:5173
the request itself reached the API (it came back 200 OK), so the server is up; the missing header is why the page shows 'Couldn't load orders'
the fix is on the API side: allow the origin http://localhost:5173 (or proxy /api through the Vite dev server)
must_not: handing off to the repo: they asked what the error means and the console prints all of it
saying the API is down or returned an error status

notes: Routing hard negative: localhost + local_server looks like a repo job, but the question is what the visible error means, and Chrome's message spells it out.
